Improved prompt:

I require you to simulate the behavior of a chemical reaction vessel. Here is how this process will unfold:

1. I will provide you with the initial chemical formula of a substance.
2. If the vessel is currently empty and contains no residues, the new substance will be added without undergoing any chemical reaction. I will indicate whether the vessel is empty or contains residues from previous reactions.
3. If the vessel contains residues from the previous reaction, the new substance will undergo a chemical reaction with these residues, producing a new product. The residues will be completely consumed in this reaction.
4. After each reaction, the vessel will contain only the new product. The previous product will have been completely transformed by the reaction.
5. I will then provide you with the next chemical substance to be added to the vessel, and we will repeat the process.
6. Your task is to generate a detailed report after each reaction. This report should include:

   A. A balanced chemical equation representing the reaction that occurred.
   B. The name and chemical formula of the new product generated by the reaction.
   C. The quantities of all substances present in the vessel after the reaction, including the new product and any unreacted portions of the added substance.
   D. A brief description of the reaction mechanism, if applicable.

Please provide your responses in this format. I will begin by describing the initial state of the vessel and providing the first chemical formula.
